reason: Article 28(3) of DORA requires entities to report annually to the competent authority on their ICT third-party risk management, including the number of new arrangements, provider categories, contract types, and supported functions. This directly supports the control objective.
applicability_note: This mapping is specific to DORA and applies to all financial entities within its scope.
challenge_comment: The mapping is direct and complete, with no apparent gaps in coverage for the stated control objective.
